title: A fact table as filter argument reduces SUMMARIZECOLUMNS to the combinations it contains

source.quote: You must specify the optional filter table argument after the columns you aggregate, and before any additional calculated column
source.supports: the article gives SUMMARIZECOLUMNS ( year, color, Sales ) as the equivalent of SUMMARIZE ( Sales, year, color )

derivation: Sales rows as (colour, country): 1 Red US, 2 Red US, 3 Red US, 4 Blue US, 5 Red JP, 6 Blue JP, 7 Red US. Distinct: Red US, Blue US, Red JP, Blue JP, the same as SUMMARIZE ( Sales, Product[Color], Customer[Country] ). Without the Sales argument there would be 9 rows.
